source_note: Official program-level admissions research for Tsinghua University and Kyoto University.

rows.semantics: The Department of Computer Science and Technology states that annual undergraduate enrollment is about 160 students. Students are admitted through the National College Entrance Examination and a special waiver channel, but the official page does not publish a public applicant total, so no acceptance rate can be derived.

provenance.source: Student Admission - Department of Computer Science and Technology
provenance.method: Direct annual undergraduate enrollment figure published by the department; no public applicant count is exposed, so the row is stored as capacity rather than an acceptance rate.

rows.semantics: Kyoto iUP is a 4.5-year scholarship program combining a six-month preparatory course and four years of undergraduate study. Kyoto University publishes successful-applicant totals for the program as a whole. This is a program-level admissions flow, not a faculty-by-faculty major rate.

sources.label: Kyoto iUP October 2025 successful applicants announcement

provenance.source: Announcement of Successful Candidates for October 2025 Enrollment
provenance.method: Calculated from official Kyoto iUP counts (37 successful applicants / 795 applicants).
